capabilities: Render live exchange rates from inline code spans
Convert amounts inline with an optional amount in the code span
Insert rates through a pick-from/to/amount/date modal command
Convert selected text via a command
Cache rates in memory for an hour
extras: Built and maintained by UniRateAPI itself (vendor disclosure); not yet approved on the community plugin list, so manual installation is required; historical rates back to 1999 and commodities (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD) need a paid UniRateAPI Pro plan.
intentEvidence: Existing Obsidian finance plugins are either crypto-only (obsidian-crypto-lookup) or general-purpose calculators
motivation: Existing finance plugins are crypto-only or general-purpose calculators, none offer inline live rates, and a 2022 forum request for this remains unanswered.
problem: Obsidian has no way to show live currency rates inline in prose; existing finance plugins are crypto-only or calculator-style rather than inline.

relations.evidence: Existing Obsidian finance plugins are either crypto-only (obsidian-crypto-lookup)
or general-purpose calculators that happen to handle currency (obsidian-numerals)

summary: Inline currency converter that renders live and historical exchange rates from inline code spans like `usd:eur` or `usd:eur:100` via UniRateAPI.
